system.description:
You can tweak and adapt equipment on the fly.

Prerequisite: Tech Specialist

Effect: You can exchange a Trait you have applied to a piece of Equipment or Droid for another one by spending 1 minute to make a DC 20 Mechanics check. If you succeed, the Equipment loses the old Trait and gains a new Trait until the end of the encounter, at which point the device loses all Traits previously acquired through use of the Tech Specialist Feat.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
